user.title: Sigen Energy for ELAN
user.description: Pick where the solar, grid and battery readings come from. Sigen Energy for ELAN reads that integration's entities and adds the energy model, the universal energy entities and the dashboard screens.

enphase.title: Enphase
enphase.description: Pick the Envoy with the grid meter (net-consumption CT) and, with several Envoys, how the other arrays are wired. Daily totals come from the Envoys' lifetime meters.

data.enable_readings: Turn on the Envoy's per-leg voltage and current (for the Power screen)

abort.no_source: Set up Sigenergy ESS first; no Sigenergy integration was found.
abort.already_configured: Sigen Energy for ELAN is already set up for this source.

data.energy_price_entity: Electricity price sensor ($/kWh) for daily cost
data.energy_typical_lookup: Look up typical solar output from NREL PVWatts (sends approximate home location)
data.energy_snapshot_file: Publish the dashboard image as a file under /local (no login needed; unguessable name)
data.energy_publish_dir: Also publish the screens as JPG files to this folder (optional)

data_description.energy_battery: Shows the battery page, the battery in the live flow, battery charts and battery cards on the screens and dashboards. Untick for sites without a battery to hide them everywhere.
data_description.energy_publish_dir: Full path of a folder another web server on this machine already serves, e.g. a local web folder. Each screen is written there as overview.jpg, live.jpg, today.jpg, battery.jpg, money.jpg, solar.jpg and week.jpg, with fixed names and no login. Leave empty to turn off.
data_description.energy_publish_png: Writes every screen a second time as a PNG with a see-through background (same names, .png), so it blends into the controller's own background. Made for every panel and browser, old ones included: cards are drawn as outlines and every pixel is either fully clear or fully solid. Uses about twice the processing of the JPGs.

rate_plan.title: Electricity rate plan
rate_plan.description: Time-of-use prices for this site. Write one row per line as `HH:MM price name`, e.g. `16:00 0.64 On-peak`; each row lasts until the next and every day must start at 00:00. Months: `6-9` or `1,2,3`. Leave the weekend box empty to reuse weekday rows, and leave season 2 empty for a single all-year season. Tiered plans and more seasons can be set over the API (sigen_energy.set_tariff). {error}

abort.energy_not_loaded: Sigen Energy for ELAN must be running to edit the rate plan.

error.invalid_publish_dir: Enter a full folder path starting with /, without '..'.

energy_array_settings.title: Enter the solar array details
energy_array_settings.description: Sigen Energy for ELAN uses placeholder values (10 x 400 W panels) for the solar array. Open the Sigen Energy for ELAN device and set Solar Panel Count and Solar Panel Watts (and optionally tilt, azimuth and commissioning date) so the efficiency and typical-output metrics are correct. This notice clears once they are set.

energy_array_too_small.title: Solar panel settings are smaller than what the inverter measures
energy_array_too_small.description: The panels are set to {configured} kW, but the inverter has measured {measured} kW coming in from them. Panels can't deliver more than their rating, so the panel count or watts per panel must be too low. On a clear day the inverter usually sees no more than about 80% of the array rating, which puts this array at {minimum} kW or more. Check the optimizer count in the SolarEdge monitoring portal or SetApp (one optimizer per panel) and the panel model, then correct Solar Panel Count and Solar Panel Watts on the Sigen Energy for ELAN device. Until then, typical output, efficiency and the cleaning indicator are wrong.

energy_array_too_large.title: Solar panel settings look too large for the inverter
energy_array_too_large.description: The panels are set to {configured} kW, more than twice the inverter's {inverter} kW rating. Inverters are rarely paired with that much panel power. Check Solar Panel Count and Solar Panel Watts on the Sigen Energy for ELAN device; a common mistake is entering the total array size as the watts per panel.

energy_location_missing.title: Set the home location for solar metrics
energy_location_missing.description: Home Assistant's home location is not set (latitude and longitude are 0). Sigen Energy for ELAN uses it for sunrise and sunset and for the typical-output lookup, so typical output and efficiency are wrong until it is set. Set it in Settings > System > General, then restart Home Assistant.
